title: About
text:
M.Sc. student in Risk and Safety at the Technical University of Munich (from winter semester 2026/27), supported by a DAAD Study Scholarship. B.A. from Yonsei University in Quantitative Risk Management, Sociology, and Library and Information Science.
My work sits where organisational risk, communication failure, and socio-technical systems meet. Methodologically it draws on computational text analysis (structural topic models, network analysis), quantitative risk modelling, and sociological theory (Luhmann, SCOT, ANT).

title: Projects
text:
Computational and quantitative work on risk, communication, and socio-technical systems. Each entry links to a project page and, where available, to its code.




Twenty Years of Culture and Society: A Structural Topic Model
2026 · STM, text analysis, R
STM-based analysis of two decades of articles in the Korean sociology journal 문화와사회. Published in 문화와사회 34(1), 2026 (co-authored).
DetailsGitHub ↗Paper ↗



K-Pop Collaboration Networks
network analysis, igraph, visNetwork, R
Bipartite projection of artist–producer collaborations, analysed and visualised with igraph and visNetwork in R.
DetailsGitHub ↗



LLM Personas in Deliberative Forums
agent-based simulation, LLM, computational social science
Simulation study of LLM-driven personas in deliberative discussion, observing toxicity amplification and echo chamber formation.
DetailsGitHub ↗



Framing the Serious Accidents Punishment Act
framing analysis, BIGKinds, systems theory
Computational framing analysis of Korean newspaper editorials on the Serious Accidents Punishment Act (중대재해처벌법), using BIGKinds data and read through Luhmann's systems theory.
